senses.definition: (interrogative) What person or people; which person or people; asks for the identity of someone; used in a direct or indirect question.
examples: You're getting married‽ Who to? (direct question)
I don't know who it is. (indirect question)
Who says they care? —They themselves do.
Who is coming to your party? Who are your favourite singers?

senses.definition: (relative) Introduces a relative clause having a human antecedent.

examples: That's the man who works at the newsagent. (defining)
My sister, who works in the accounts department, just got promoted to manager. (non-defining)

senses.definition: (fused relative, archaic or marginal) Whoever, he who, they who.
examples: Who insults my mother insults me.
Give it to who deserves it.

quotes.text: Who steals my purse steals trash.
